senses.gloss:
† लेप् लेप्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To go.
 2. To serve (?).

लेप लेप, i. e. लिप् + अ, m.
 1. Smearing, plastering, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 748.
 2. Mortar, plaster, MBh. 1, 5724.
 3. Stain, spot.
 4. The wipings of the hand which has offered funeral oblations to three ancestors, these wipings being considered as an oblation to ancestors in the fourth, fifth, and sixth degrees.
 5. Food, Man. 3, 210.
 --Comp.
लेपक लेपक, i. e. लिप् + अक, m. A bricklayer, a plasterer.
लेपकर लेप-कर, m. A writer, Rām. 1, 12, 17.

लेपन लेपन, i. e. लिप् + अन, n.
 1. Anointing, Lass. 11, 2.
 2. Smearing. []
 3. Plastering, Chr. 57, 22; Rām. 2, 91, 41 (both at the end of comp. adj. Plastered with).
 4. Mortar, Man. 6, 76.
 --Comp.
ऽलेपिन् -लेपिन्, i. e. लेप + इन्, adj. Having a plastering; in प्रभा-, adj. Covered with splendour, Vikr. d. 125.
लेप्यकृत् लेप्य-कृ + त् (vb. लिप्), m. A bricklayer, a plasterer.
लेप्यमयी लेप्यमयी, i. e. लेप्य + मय + ई (vb. लिप्), f. A doll.
